evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the now commands erasure of a category of knowledge — present focus, irrealis (desired state-change), abstract target.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative seeking a non-actual desired state; target is a category of knowledge, not a specific event.
